detail.body:
## Changes

Enable encoder SWA bounded replay with DP attention at attention TP=1. Pack prefix tails within the resolved per-rank prefill budget, synchronize replay rounds and let ranks without hits participate idly. Invalidate preplanned verification metadata after replay and keep temporary replay batches eager. Reuse the existing platform/model checks; require at least 128 prefill tokens per attention DP rank.

TRT-LLM and prefill CUDA graphs remain unsupported with bounded replay.

## Accuracy

DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, 2×GB300, TP2/DP2/EP2, MegaMoE + FlashMLA, native DSpark acceptance. GSM8K: 1,314 scored questions, five-shot chat, thinking disabled, temperature 0, concurrency 64, max output 4,096 tokens.

| Configuration | Correct | Accuracy | Request errors |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Replay disabled | 1,278 / 1,314 | 97.26% | 0 |
| Encoder replay enabled | 1,281 / 1,314 | 97.49% | 0 |

One encoder-replay completion reached the output limit; the baseline had none.

+def run_encoder_swa_replay(worker, batch, forward_batch=None):
+    runner = worker.model_runner
+    window = runner.token_to_kv_pool.request_window
+    dp = get_parallel().attn_dp_size > 1
+    current = batch if batch is not None else forward_batch
+    if window is None or current is None:
+        return
+    if dp:
+        # This flag is shared by all target ranks, including a coordinated
+        # verification peer handed only a pre-planned ForwardBatch.
+        if not current.is_extend_in_batch:
+            return
+        # The resolved schedule budget has already been divided across DP ranks.
+        max_rows = get_schedule().chunked_prefill_size

+            )
+    else:
+        max_rows = 128
+    groups = _replay_groups(batch, window, max_rows)
+    sizes = [sum(min(batch.prefix_lens[i], 128) for i in group) for group in groups]
+    all_sizes = get_parallel().tp_group.all_gather_object(sizes) if dp else [sizes]
+    rounds = max(map(len, all_sizes))
+    for step in range(rounds):
+        counts = [sizes[step] if step < len(sizes) else 0 for sizes in all_sizes]
